title: Scenario, revision, and branch UX productization
scope: Frontend product UX and local ProjectV2 compatibility storage only

project.storage: ProjectV2 workspace persisted in IndexedDB with localStorage fallback
project.selection: One active project at a time

scenario.storage: Flat project.scenarios snapshots with id, name, plan, summary, artifacts, and requiresRerun
scenario.switching: Project menu opened a snapshot immediately and restored its plan; no version selection existed
scenario.active_semantics: A matching autosaved draft kept activeScenarioId; a changed draft cleared activeScenarioId
scenario.dirty_state: Command bar exposed local persistence state, while the scenario surface did not distinguish Saved from Unsaved changes
scenario.save_current: Each Save current action created another top-level Scenario snapshot
scenario.delete: Scenario deletion was available from the project menu with an in-app undo toast
scenario.duplicate: Only whole-project duplication was available; Scenario duplication had no independent-lineage explanation

version_history.domain_support: The compatibility adapter already accepted additive domain.revisions records from earlier domain work
version_history.ui_support: No Version history, parent revision, change summary, input diff, restore, or continue-from-version surface
version_history.hydration: Opening a saved snapshot could restore cached artifacts; there was no explicit metadata-only Version inspection

optimization.historical_apply: Run History exposed Apply to new revision, but the flow required the current Scenario and used its current revision as the source
optimization.lineage: Originating Run and solution IDs existed in domain support but were not consistently exposed as friendly Version lineage

run_and_report.run_history: Rows showed raw ScenarioRevision or Draft labels and had no source Version navigation
run_and_report.reports: Retained artifacts showed raw ScenarioRevision identity and source Run IDs, but no friendly Scenario + Version navigation
run_and_report.comparison: The existing Results comparison compared flat summary KPIs, not Scenario + Version input state; it did not offer semantic compatibility gating for retained Run result comparison

retention_and_limits.cached_scenario_artifact_retention: At most five newest scenarios retain compact cached artifacts; older scenario artifacts are nulled and requiresRerun is set
retention_and_limits.large_result_policy: Run History and Report Artifact stores are additive local stores; large RF arrays are not intended to become Scenario Version payloads

pre_change_validation.frontend_build: passed with the existing bundle-size warning
pre_change_validation.interpretation: These figures describe the 7D baseline immediately before 7E implementation; they are not 7E completion evidence

non_goals: RF propagation, interference, optimization, or backend algorithm changes
Remote collaboration, authentication, server-side persistence, or database migration
Automatic RF reruns when switching, inspecting, restoring, branching, or applying a solution
